community.name: react-native-reanimated
community.statusNote: macOS pod target and New-Architecture-only implementation; use a Reanimated/RN-macOS compatible version pair (this deck uses 4.3.4 / RN-macOS 0.81.7). Latest npm is not a recommendation for RN-macOS 0.81. Windows native integration is not supported; Windows-hosted Android build CI does not establish RN Windows support.

community.name: react-native-gesture-handler
community.statusNote: macOS Fabric example explicitly enables the New Architecture. Use a matching version: Gesture Handler 3 requires RN >=0.82; the 2.x line is needed for RN-macOS 0.81. Windows module is a no-op shim, not gesture support.

community.name: react-native-svg
community.statusNote: macOS has a Fabric example and platform source. Windows Fabric renders basic geometry but explicitly registers unsupported components for text/TSpan, masks, patterns, markers, symbols, foreignObject and filters.

community.name: react-native-webview
community.statusNote: Default npm latest 14.0.1 supports macOS Fabric but not Windows Fabric. Windows Fabric landed in v15; v16 also exists, but is not npm latest. v16 has an open blank-URL-source report (#3990). The Windows cross is for the default release, not a claim that no Fabric implementation exists.

community.name: react-native-mmkv
community.statusNote: Released NitroMmkv podspec targets macOS and uses Nitro. No released Windows package integration; Nitro Windows work is still unmerged. Generic C++ MMKV portability does not establish RN Windows support.

community.name: @shopify/react-native-skia
community.statusNote: Released macOS frameworks and Apple implementation support Fabric. Maintainer confirmed macOS landed; Windows requires a separate backend/integration and is not shipped.

community.name: react-native-vision-camera
community.statusNote: Released podspec targets iOS/visionOS, with Android implementation; no upstream macOS or Windows target found. In progress is Jay's explicitly supplied desktop roadmap, not a verified upstream PR or released support. Mac Catalyst is not RN-macOS.

community.name: react-native-worklets
community.statusNote: RNWorklets declares macOS, shares the Reanimated New Architecture implementation, and needs an RN-compatible version pair (this deck uses 0.8.3 with a local patch). No released RN Windows platform integration found; do not infer Windows support from portable C++ or Android-on-Windows builds.

community.name: @sentry/react-native
community.statusNote: macOS Cocoa target plus New Architecture TurboModule implementation and Fabric-configurable macOS sample. Windows is JS error reporting only with native integrations disabled; no native crashes/replay via this SDK. macOS support does not imply all mobile features such as replay work.

community.name: @react-native-community/netinfo
community.statusNote: macOS New Architecture supported in released 12.0.1: shared Apple RNCNetInfo.mm implements NativeRNCNetInfoSpec and getTurboModule under RCT_NEW_ARCH_ENABLED, with explicit TARGET_OS_OSX branches; the podspec targets macOS and installs New Architecture dependencies. Earlier audit incorrectly inferred legacy-only integration from the header. Windows remains in progress: UWP project, unmerged PR #805.

community.name: react-native-nitro-modules
community.statusNote: Released macOS pod target and JSI runtime support. Windows New Architecture implementations are in open, unmerged PRs; not a released Windows checkmark.

replacementSelection.metric: Monthly npm downloads reported by Directory; native-code filter; excludes Expo and all original community rows. This is not Directory popularity score.

expoFeatured.name: expo-constants
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS pod target and native Constants implementation through Expo Modules Core. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-file-system
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS support confirmed by Jay on 2026-09-22; show as supported. Core file operations have an upstream macOS target. The source audit found picker API gaps, which do not change this module-level status. Windows: no upstream Expo Modules Core Windows integration; adapters and forks are outside this table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-asset
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS target and native asset downloading implementation through Expo Modules Core. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-keep-awake
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS is declared in the podspec, but isActivated returns false and setActivated only acts on iOS/tvOS. It compiles without implementing its core behavior on macOS. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-font
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS font loading is implemented, but renderToImageAsync is excluded with #if !os(macOS). Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-linking
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS pod target and Expo Linking module. It imports requireNativeModule(ExpoLinking), so JS delegation to RN Linking does not make the entire package Windows-compatible. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-secure-store
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec omits macOS; iOS/visionOS implementation is not a macOS module. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-web-browser
expoFeatured.statusNote: Explicit macOS NSWindow/WKWebView implementation and macOS authentication session path. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-application
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published EXApplication podspec omits macOS; native implementation is mobile-oriented. Main renamed the podspec to ExpoApplication; that is not the audited published file. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-symbols
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published macOS target and explicit NSImage/NSFont symbol rendering branch; ExpoView is supplied by Expo Modules Core. Symbol effects retain OS-version requirements. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-notifications
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec omits macOS; no upstream RN Windows native implementation. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-image
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec omits macOS; iOS UIKit image view does not establish RN-macOS support. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-glass-effect
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec targets iOS/tvOS, not macOS. iOS Liquid Glass is not evidence of a macOS Expo module. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-crypto
expoFeatured.statusNote: macOS target and platform-independent Apple crypto implementation through Expo Modules Core. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-image-picker
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec omits macOS; no macOS picker integration. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoFeatured.name: expo-device
expoFeatured.statusNote: Published podspec omits macOS; device code does not supply a macOS target. Windows: published Expo Modules Core registers Apple/Android only; no upstream Windows native implementation. Frame adapters, forks, web fallbacks and Expo Desktop replacement modules are outside this upstream-package table.

expoSelection.metric: Monthly npm downloads, descending, among desktop-relevant app-facing Expo packages.
expoSelection.excluded: Mobile status/system UI, mobile splash screens, haptics, build/dev tooling, core umbrella package and internal infrastructure packages. Router omitted at Jay's request; symbols and glass retained for native desktop UI.

expoPresentationEvidence.title: State of React Native macOS — React Native London
expoPresentationEvidence.note: Speaker notes state these Expo modules already work on Mac. Historical speaker evidence, not a new runtime test or evidence of Windows support.

architectureAudit.scope: Onstage community and expoFeatured rows only. Source audit for New Architecture, not runtime certification. Supported requires a compatible RN/platform/library version; latest inspected is not always compatible with RN-macOS 0.81. Default npm latest defines WebView Windows status.
architectureAudit.historicalData: Top-level checkedAt/source, expo and ranking arrays retain the September 21 Directory snapshot; their architecture-unspecified flags are not used for this audit.
